// This fixture declares a PropertyType constant whose value is a conversion
// rather than a literal, so the walk finds a spec it is meant to read and an
// expression it cannot take a string off.
//
// The block holds nothing else: were the refusal to drop the spec instead,
// this file would read as an empty table, which is the silent outcome the
// row about it asserts against.
package graph

// PropertyType is the type whose constants the walk collects.
type PropertyType string

const TypeDerived PropertyType = PropertyType("DERIVED")
